luna_triage.reason: The current paper explicitly treats Ebbinghaus's 1880 and 1885 texts as sources for the same classic forgetting experiment and curve. Its 1885 report is another account/publication of the same original work represented by the supplied 1880 row, not an independent target. The source distinguishes their curve fitting and the introduction of the savings measure, but the replication target is the classic forgetting experiment/curve as a whole.
